acceptance: Fuel samples at GT inlet within limits during LDO tests
text: LDO as delivered per ALP-OWN-FUL-002 (TS EN 590 based: density 820-845 kg/m3, viscosity 2.0-4.5 mm2/s at 40 degC, flash point >= 55 degC, sulphur <= 10 mg/kg, water <= 200 mg/kg, ash <= 0.01 %, FAME <= 7 %, LHV 42.6-43.2 MJ/kg). At the gas turbine fuel inlet: Na + K <= 0.5 mg/kg, vanadium <= 0.5 mg/kg, lead <= 1.0 mg/kg, calcium <= 2.0 mg/kg, water <= 100 mg/kg, filtration to 5 um, or stricter OEM limits.
title: Light diesel oil specification and burner limits
